Title: Generally available: Customize application text labels in Azure IoT Central

Body.Content:
You can now customize the application text labels in your Azure IoT Central application. With this new capability, you can replace the ‘Device’ label in your application to your preferred text. To customize the text labels in your application, navigate to ‘Text’ page in the ‘Customization’ section under ‘Settings’. Then you can select a language to download the customization file, make updates to the right-handed side strings in the JSON file, and then reupload the customization file to see changes in your application text labels. 

Learn more about Change application text in Azure IoT Central.
